core_obligations: Forward direction: for K perfect with dual K^vee, Hom(K, M) = H^0(X, K^vee tensor^L M) functorially in M; K^vee tensor^L - commutes with direct sums and H^0(X, -) commutes with direct sums on D_QCoh by the pushforward direct sums lemma, so Hom(K, -) converts direct sums to direct sums and K is compact (proof lines 4471-4482).

Converse, reduction to affines: perfectness is local, so it suffices to show K|_U is perfect for every affine open U; the inclusion j : U -> X is quasi-compact separated, Rj_* commutes with direct sums, and by adjunction of restriction and Rj_* the restriction K|_U is compact in D_QCoh(O_U) (proof lines 4485-4496).
Affine case: by the affine comparison the problem becomes compactness in D(A), where the More on Algebra proposition states compact objects are perfect; conclude K is perfect (proof lines 4499-4502).
proof_roadmap: Prove perfect implies compact via the dual and direct-sum commutation (proof lines 4471-4482).
Restrict compactness to affine opens using Rj_* commuting with direct sums (proof lines 4485-4496).
Conclude in the affine case from the More on Algebra compactness proposition (proof lines 4499-4502).
